summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Annual General Meeting and explanatory memorandum. The filing is a routine meeting notice with agenda items including financial statements review, appointment of two directors, and an ESOP resolution. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other corporate actions. The filing is a standard annual meeting notification with no transaction terms, board recommendations on a deal, or advisors. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a proxy statement for an annual shareholder meeting. No special situation is present.
